Theme

bronze noun

the metal; copper

also copper, brass, bronze (metal), coppers (money)

classical

Plin. NH 34.163: India neque aes neque plumbum habet (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Fam. 5.6: habēre aes aliēnum (Lewis & Short)

aes, aeris n.

noun, third declension

copper; bronze; money

Any ore but gold and silver, above all copper, and its alloy with tin, bronze; then anything made of it, and money, which was first of copper. Aes aliēnum, another’s money, is debt (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • India neque aes neque plumbum habet

    India has neither copper nor leadPlin. NH 34.163 (Lewis & Short)

See also bronze, debt, money, metal, tin.
